Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.database.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Singleton JDBC manager for the FA1 global leaderboard. Reads connection parameters from db.properties on the classpath. All public methods are synchronized — GameController calls them from the game thread, while the shutdown hook calls close() from another thread. Graceful degradation: every public method throws Exception upward. GameController catches it and logs "[DB] Ranking unavailable" without crashing the game.

    • saveGameResults

      public void saveGameResults(List<Player> players, int numPlayers, LocalDate date) throws SQLException
      Inserts one row per player using a batch INSERT. Called once at game end by GameController.onGameOver().
      Parameters:
      players - list of players whose results will be saved
      numPlayers - total number of players in the game (used for leaderboard filtering)
      date - date the game was played
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the batch insert fails

    • getRanking

      public List<RankingEntry> getRanking(int numPlayers) throws SQLException
      Returns all historical results for games of the given player count, ordered by score DESC with SQL RANK() assigned sequentially. Requires MySQL 8+ or PostgreSQL 9.4+.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players to filter by
      Returns:
      ranked list of all results for the given player count
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • getPlayerRank

      public int getPlayerRank(String nickname, int score, int numPlayers) throws SQLException
      Returns the historical rank of a specific player for games of a given player count. Uses COUNT to avoid a second window-function query.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      score - the player's score to rank against historical results
      numPlayers - number of players to filter by
      Returns:
      1-based rank (1 = best score)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the JDBC connection. Called by CombinedServer's shutdown hook.
